en: The postcard shows a tranquil riverside scene at sunset or dawn. There are several wooden boats and a ferry barge on a wide river. The barge appears to carry a horse-drawn wagon and several people. On the shore, a small group of people, including children, are gathered. The banks are sandy and natural, with dense green foliage in the background. The card is printed in color with the title 'Belgern. Partie a. d. Elbe. Fähre.' at the top.
